prose: A Reuters report that Chinese local governments are offering subsidies - computing vouchers, rent waivers and deductions - to fuel a rush to turn AI video into an industry. The body was not captured (fetch error), so this summary rests on the headline.

On that basis: after large models, AI-generated video is the next sector getting the full local-government industrial-policy treatment in China - cheap compute and free rent to seed a cluster. Which cities and companies feature is unknown from the capture.
